Professional Indemnity

Tailored protection for professionals in high-liability fields.

Frequently Asked Questions

Who needs professional indemnity insurance?

Doctors, lawyers, architects, engineers, chartered accountants, consultants, and any professional whose advice or service could cause financial loss to clients. It covers legal defense costs and damages awarded.

What does professional indemnity cover?

Legal defense costs, settlements, and damages for claims of negligence, errors, omissions, or breach of professional duty. Coverage is claims-made (claim must be reported during policy period). We tailor limits based on your profession's risk profile.
